name: Pixel Pulse for WooCommerce
author: LogikLabs

sections.description:
🚀 PixelPulse for WooCommerce

Transform your WooCommerce store with PixelPulse – the ultimate analytics plugin for tracking, optimizing, and growing your business. Gain valuable insights and take control of your store’s performance by integrating with Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, and more.

✨ Why Choose PixelPulse?

  • 🎯 All-in-One Tracking Solution
    Say goodbye to juggling multiple tools! PixelPulse brings all your tracking into one powerful, easy-to-use plugin.

  • ⏱️ Real-Time Event Tracking
    Stay ahead of the game by monitoring key customer actions instantly, like add-to-cart, checkouts, and purchases.

  • 🔮 Future-Ready
    PixelPulse is designed for growth, with upcoming integrations for LinkedIn, Pinterest, Microsoft, TikTok, X, and Clarity.

🌟 Key Features You’ll Love

  • 🌐 Multi-Platform Integration
    Track smarter, not harder. PixelPulse supports Google Analytics and Meta Pixel, with even more platforms coming soon.

  • 📈 Real-Time Event Tracking
    Track critical events like add-to-cart, checkout, and purchases as they happen.

  • ⚙️ Customizable Settings
    Easily configure tracking codes and toggle events to fit your business needs.

  • 📊 Detailed Analytics
    Get to know your customers like never before with deep insights into behavior and marketing performance.

  • 💡 User-Friendly Interface
    A streamlined dashboard ensures quick setup so you can focus on what matters most – your store.

💎 What Makes PixelPulse Stand Out?

  • Unmatched Flexibility: Tailored tracking for every store.
  • Future-Proof Design: New integrations always on the horizon.
  • Easy to Use: No coding needed – just plug and play!
  • Real Results: Drive better decisions with actionable data.

📥 Ready to Take Control of Your WooCommerce Store?
Download PixelPulse now and unlock the full potential of your analytics!

External Services

PixelPulse integrates with third-party analytics and tracking services to provide comprehensive ecommerce tracking functionality. Below are the details of each service, including the domains accessed, data transmitted, and the specific events triggered.

1. Google Analytics (via Google Tag Manager)

  • Service Purpose: Tracks user behavior and ecommerce events to provide analytics data for store performance insights.

  • Domains Used:

    • https://www.googletagmanager.com
    • https://www.google-analytics.com

  • Events and Data Sent:

    1. Page Views:
    • Triggered: On every page load.
    • Purpose: Tracks the pages visited by users to monitor site traffic and behavior.
      1. Add to Cart:
    • Triggered: When a product is added to the cart.
    • Purpose: Tracks product popularity and user purchasing intent.
      1. Remove from Cart:
    • Triggered: When a product is removed from the cart.
    • Purpose: Helps analyze user decision-making and cart abandonment trends.
      1. View Cart:
    • Triggered: When a user views their shopping cart.
    • Purpose: Monitors user interaction with the cart page.
      1. Purchase Events:
    • Triggered: After a successful purchase.
    • Purpose: Tracks completed orders, including customer details and purchased products.
      1. Checkout Steps:
    • Triggered: At each step of the checkout process (e.g., billing, shipping).
    • Purpose: Monitors checkout flow to identify drop-off points.
      1. Cart Abandonment:
    • Triggered: When a user leaves the site with items in their cart.
    • Purpose: Identifies potential revenue loss from incomplete purchases.
      1. Coupon Usage:
    • Triggered: When a coupon is applied or removed during checkout.
    • Purpose: Tracks the effectiveness of promotional campaigns.
      1. Dynamic Pricing Events:
    • Triggered: When a user adjusts product quantities or prices change dynamically.
    • Purpose: Tracks how users interact with variable pricing features.

  • Service Provider: Google LLC

  • Terms of Service: Google Terms
  • Privacy Policy: Google Privacy

2. Meta (Facebook) Pixel

  • Service Purpose: Tracks user behavior for advertising, remarketing, and analytics purposes.

  • Domains Used:

    • https://connect.facebook.net
    • https://www.facebook.com

  • Events and Data Sent:

    1. Page Views:
    • Triggered: On every page load.
    • Purpose: Tracks user visits and monitors site engagement for ad targeting.
      1. Add to Cart:
    • Triggered: When a product is added to the cart.
    • Purpose: Identifies users interested in specific products for remarketing.
      1. Remove from Cart:
    • Triggered: When a product is removed from the cart.
    • Purpose: Monitors changes in purchase intent.
      1. Purchase Events:
    • Triggered: After a successful purchase.
    • Purpose: Tracks conversions for advertising campaigns and optimizes ad spend.
      1. Cart Abandonment:
    • Triggered: When a user leaves the site with items in their cart.
    • Purpose: Supports remarketing campaigns to recover lost sales.
      1. Coupon Interactions:
    • Triggered: When a coupon is applied or removed during checkout.
    • Purpose: Measures the performance and appeal of promotional offers.
      1. Dynamic Pricing Events:
    • Triggered: When a user changes product quantities or interacts with pricing on the product page.
    • Purpose: Tracks dynamic pricing features for personalized marketing.

  • Service Provider: Meta Platforms, Inc.

  • Terms of Service: Meta Terms
  • Privacy Policy: Meta Privacy
  1. Future Integrations (Coming Soon)
    The following services are planned for future releases:

– LinkedIn Pixel
– Pinterest Pixel
– Microsoft Advertising
– TikTok Pixel
– X (Twitter) Pixel
– Microsoft Clarity

Note: All data transmission to third-party services occurs only after proper user consent and in compliance with applicable privacy laws. Store owners should ensure they have appropriate privacy policies and cookie consent mechanisms in place when using these tracking features.

Important Privacy Considerations:
– All tracking includes UTM parameter collection and storage
– Customer data (email, phone) is only transmitted during specific events like purchase completion
– Cart abandonment tracking includes a 60-second inactivity timer
– All tracking respects user consent settings and privacy preferences

  • 🏢 Company Website: Learn more about LogikLabs at logiklabs.io.

sections.installation:
🛠️ Installation Instructions

  1. 📥 Download the Plugin
    Get the pixel-pulse.zip file from the official source.

  2. 🚀 Install in WordPress
    Go to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to Plugins > Add New, and click Upload Plugin.
    Select the pixel-pulse.zip file and click Install Now.

  3. ✅ Activate the Plugin
    Once installed, go to Plugins, find PixelPulse for WooCommerce, and click Activate.

  4. ⚙️ Set Up Tracking
    Navigate to Settings > Pixel Manager, add your tracking IDs (e.g., Google Analytics, Meta Pixel), and customize the settings.
    💾 Save your changes, and you’re ready to start tracking!
sections.faq:
🔍 I’m not seeing data in my dashboard. What should I check?

🛠️ Ensure all Tracking IDs are correct and that your site is connected to each platform. Verify that caching plugins aren’t blocking PixelPulse scripts.

⚙️ Can I disable tracking for specific platforms?

✔️ Yes! Navigate to Settings > Pixel Manager, remove any tracking ID you don’t want to use, and save.

📊 How can I verify that tracking is working?

🚀 Use browser tools to ensure tracking is functioning correctly. For Facebook Pixel, use a pixel helper extension to check if the pixel events are firing. For Google Analytics, use a tag assistant tool to inspect whether tracking codes are installed and collecting data properly.

🧩 Is PixelPulse compatible with my theme and other plugins?

🖌️ PixelPulse works seamlessly with most WooCommerce themes and plugins.

🎯 Can I track multiple platforms simultaneously?

✅ Yes! PixelPulse allows you to integrate and track multiple platforms, such as Google Analytics and Facebook Pixel, simultaneously.
